Indices of triangles and masks

Source: R/numpy_array2.R
jnp_triu_indices.Rd

Ports of jnp.triu_indices, jnp.tril_indices, jnp.triu_indices_from, jnp.tril_indices_from and jnp.mask_indices. Indices are 0-based.

Usage

jnp_triu_indices(n, k = 0L, m = NULL)

jnp_tril_indices(n, k = 0L, m = NULL)

jnp_triu_indices_from(arr, k = 0L)

jnp_tril_indices_from(arr, k = 0L)

jnp_mask_indices(n, mask_func, k = 0L, size = NULL)

Arguments

n, m

Number of rows and columns (m defaults to n).

k

Diagonal offset.

arr

Two dimensional array (or anything with a shape).

mask_func

Function (array, k) returning a mask array, such as jnp_triu().

size

Static number of indices to return (see jnp_nonzero()).

Value

A list of two integer arrays.
